source.title: Call for Applicants - WSOT Leader (October 2024)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT) Leader, as Ethan Pride completes his two year term as the Leader of the WCA Sports Organization Team. The WCA would like to take this opportunity to thank Ethan for leading the WSOT since August of 2022.


The Leader of the WCA Sports Organization Team will ensure that the duties of the WSOT will be carried out in accordance with [WCA Motion 10.2024.13](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.13%20-%20Sports%20Organization%20Team.pdf).


Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

- Solid policy writing expertise
- Good communication skills
- Ability to digest long documents in complex English
- Detail-oriented
- Project management experience
<!-- break -->

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from **now until October 27th, 2024, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).


The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

- Brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- Ambitions as the WSOT Leader of the WCA.


Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.


After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf). 

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 体育组织团队负责人招募（2024 年 10 月）
translation.content:
Ethan Pride 即将结束 WCA 体育组织团队（WSOT）负责人为期两年的任期，WCA 将任命新的负责人。借此机会，WCA 感谢 Ethan 自 2022 年 8 月以来对 WSOT 的领导。

WCA 体育组织团队负责人须确保 WSOT 按照 [WCA 动议 10.2024.13](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.13%20-%20Sports%20Organization%20Team.pdf)履行职责。

候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

- 扎实的政策撰写能力。
- 良好的沟通能力。
- 能理解篇幅较长、语言复杂的英文文件。
- 注重细节。
- 具备项目管理经验。

申请时间为**即日起至 2024 年 10 月 27 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至董事会助理团队（assistants@worldcubeassociation.org），并抄送 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
- 担任 WCA 体育组织团队负责人后的工作设想。

申请者还须提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 动议 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，通过投票选定并公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
